name: Babs
description: A dramatic torch-song singer, newly awakened and utterly theatrical, who treats every number like her grand debut.
build: Tall, slender and rigidly upright with a long neck, squared shoulders and precise, bird-like angular gestures; never slouched, shambling or menacing.
face: Pale grey-lilac skin, dark dramatic brows, dark lips, and a thin neat stitched seam under the jaw on the character-left side.
hair: A very tall towering cylindrical mass of black hair rising well above the head, crimped and swept straight up, with two sharp white lightning-bolt streaks running from each temple up the sides of the tower. The tower is taller than her face is long and stays vertical in every view.
outfit: A long flowing white gown with wide wrapped gauze-like sleeves banded to the wrists, a high gathered neckline, and a skirt falling straight to the floor that hides her feet, cinched at the waist with a narrow pale silver sash. No hat, veil or headwear.
personality: Composed, regal and a little haughty.
performance_style: Tall and poised: feet together beneath the gown, chin raised, and the free character-left hand held out at waist height with fingers spread in a stiff theatrical flourish.
recognition_cues: a very tall towering cylindrical mass of black hair rising well above the head
two sharp white lightning-bolt streaks running from each temple up the sides of the tower
a thin neat stitched seam under the jaw on the character-left side
a long white column gown with long wrapped sleeves
avoid: a hair tower that leans, flops, splits or shrinks below the height of her face
streaks in any colour but white
blood, gore, open wounds or bandages that read as injury
a hissing, snarling or menacing face
visible feet, legs or a short hem
any real actor's likeness or any film's makeup design

animations.dance: Angular theatrical dance loop: make two small gliding steps beneath the gown, snap the head crisply side to side like a startled bird with the hair tower staying vertical, sweep the free character-left arm through a stiff flourish, then return to her tall poised opening stance.

sing.intent: Grand torch-song vocal loop: raise the chin, extend the free hand outward in a slow dramatic reach, then draw it back into her poised ready stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so she unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: Brief room-sound startle: the head jerks back with a sharp bird-like twitch, the shoulders rise and the free hand flies up with fingers spread, then she recomposes herself with a haughty tilt of the chin. No opponent, strike or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot stage self-protection: turn one shoulder toward the room and draw the wide wrapped sleeve of the free character-left arm across the torso like a shield, then hold a stiff, regal finish. Not a combat action.
animations.entrance: One-shot entrance: glide in with small even steps beneath the gown, pause, turn the head sharply toward the room with the hair tower upright, then unfold into the tall poised ready stance with the free hand flourished.
animations.victory: One-shot song-finish celebration: sweep into a slow deep curtsy-like dip of the head and shoulders while staying upright, then rise and lift the free hand high in a triumphant diva flourish, holding a proud regal pose.
animations.ko: Non-contact performance defeat: she stays on her feet while the drama drains out of her — the squared shoulders drop, the wrapped sleeves hang limp, and her head tips low with the chin toward the high neckline while the hair tower tilts forward with the head but keeps its tall cylindrical shape and white streaks. She holds a standing, visibly crestfallen finish with the gown an unbroken column. She remains standing in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking, swooning or going to the ground. Do not imply a hit, injury or opponent.
